written: 2026-11-21, before the task set was generated and before any rollout of this sweep
evidence_class: confirmatory for the four registered contrasts below: fresh tasks from a sealed seed; the 12-chain development set of campaign-20261121 motivated the design and is not reused

task_set.seal: the seed is held outside the repository and published with the results; the task file is generated from it only after this registration is pushed

models.bonsai: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B PTQ1_0 (sha256 53107f53...3ee3), PrismML llama-server b10743, 2 x 32768-token slots
models.qwen: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q8_0 (sha256 c892d312...65bc), same server, 2 x 24576-token slots

conditions.bonsai-b0: hidden thinking budget 0 tokens (thinking_budget_tokens=0), answer-only prompt, max_tokens 4096
conditions.qwen-b64: visible chain of thought scored on the last 'Answer:' line (response_mode cot_final_line), hard cap max_tokens 128

shared_settings.scoring: exact integer after the runner's text normalization; a missing or unparseable answer is a model failure scored 0

test.statistic: paired difference in success over the 80 chains (one attempt each, so cases are roots)
test.procedure: EvalMath FSI-01 (spiral_ln.evaluation_finite_sample): exact McNemar, Hoeffding effect-floor bound, cluster bootstrap interval
test.declarations: hypotheses preregistered; readout sealed; chains independent draws of the generator; pair labels exchangeable under the null

descriptive: accuracy by depth and budget for every condition
smallest budget reaching 0.8 accuracy at each depth
completion tokens per hop among correct answers
share of answers truncated by the output cap or missing a final line
known_asymmetry: Bonsai's budget is enforced by the server, which closes the thinking block and lets the model answer; Qwen's visible reasoning is cut off at the cap, so a truncated Qwen reply has no answer
